# Data model: panel views (spec 007)

All of this is display state, built from tool results, the record and path data. None is teaching logic.

## Generated data file (skill-builder's)

`mentor/curriculum/skills-built.json`, listing built skills only; a path skill that's absent isn't built:

```json
{
  "about": "Generated by mentor/scripts/write-skills-built.mjs from mentor/tools. Don't edit.",
  "skills": {
    "easing.basic": { "review": false },
    "keyframes.types": { "review": true },
    "easing.speed_graph": { "review": true },
    "timing.offset": { "review": true },
    "transform.anchor": { "review": true },
    "parenting.null": { "review": true }
  }
}
```

## Skill table (`panel/lib/skills.js`)

Per built skill: `id`, `name` and `hard` (from `path.json`), `review` (from the data file), plus the panel's own
`command`, `snapshot`, `demo` and `check` tool names and `reason` line. A test checks each `command` has a `SKILL.md`, each
tool is in its `allowed-tools`, and each built id has a row.

| Skill | Command | Snapshot | Demo | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `easing.basic` | `/ease-mentor` | `snapshot_project` | `set_ease` | `diff_since_last` |
| `keyframes.types` | `/key-types-mentor` | `key_types_snapshot` | `key_types_demo` | `key_types_check` |
| `easing.speed_graph` | `/speed-graph-mentor` | `speed_graph_snapshot` | `speed_graph_demo` | `speed_graph_check` |
| `timing.offset` | `/offset-mentor` | `offset_snapshot` | `offset_demo` | `offset_check` |
| `transform.anchor` | `/anchor-mentor` | `anchor_snapshot` | `anchor_demo` | `anchor_check` |
| `parenting.null` | `/null-parenting-mentor` | `null_parent_snapshot` | `null_parent_demo` | `null_parent_check` |

## Lesson view (`lesson.js`)

| Field | From |
|---|---|
| `skill` | The pressed request, then whichever tool ran (a hand-over changes it) |
| `mode` | The snapshot's `mode`; absent is `lesson` |
| `focus` | The snapshot's `focus` |
| `demo_target` | The latest snapshot |
| `demo_made` | A demo tool's ok result, or the snapshot's `demo_used` where it has one |
| `null_ready` | Null's snapshot `null_ready`, or `null_ready` in a check's `codes` |
| `replied` | The learner sent anything after the opening; drops Proposed |
| `checks`, `passed` | Count of comparable check results; the latest check's own `passed` |
| `labels` | id → label, kept for the lesson (research R1) |
| `check_list` | The checklist view below |
| `saved` | `true` only on `record_lesson`'s `saved: true` in this lesson; `false` on any other result |
| `recorded_result` | The `result` the mentor sent, for a save with no pass |
| `timeline` | Offset's scale (plan P5) |

**Stage** (`stageOf`): `done` if `passed`, else `try` if `replied` or targets are non-empty, else `pick`.

## Checklist view

```text
{ summary, sub, next, proposed, stale: null | note,
  sections: [{ title, rows: [{ family, glyph, subject, word, detail, track, changed }] }],
  footer: [], outside: [], worth_a_look: [] , passed }
```

`family`: done ✓, off ✗, part ◐, none ○, prop ◇, cant ⊘, ask ?. `changed` comes from comparing with the previous check by row
key. `passed` is only ever the tool's.

## View state (`view-state.js`)

A pure function from `{ config, record status, connection, lesson, turn, error }` to one README state id, with SC-003's list
checked against the README's table.

## Record reading (`memory.js`)

`readLearnerRecord` returns `{ status: "missing" | "unreadable" | "ok", record }`. `unreadable` covers a file that won't parse or
fails the mentor's shape test, and a missing file with a `learner.json.unreadable-*` beside it (FR-095). Never written.
